arStrings.szText: "Hattar, why have you invited me to this place?"
I knew you could not resist my offer. I’ve watched you, observed you from the shadows. Your power over the dark arts is notable...but are you willing to be truly great?
(laughs) Come now, I would not ask you to break our edict. Demons must always remain our slaves, never become our masters.
What I offer is the knowledge to bind demons like the ones you see before you. My will alone sustains them.
I've sparked your interest, I see! (laughs) Go, take the Binding Stone, and we shall begin.
